transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because for the last couple years I’ve just felt low most of the time. Even when I’m at work, or at church, or around people I care about, there’s this heavy, empty feeling that doesn’t really go away.
Do you find yourself enjoying activities that you used to like?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I still do some of the things I used to like, but I don’t know if I’d say I enjoy them the same way. It’s kind of hard for me to tell.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to find pleasurable?
I don’t know if I’d say I’ve completely lost interest. I still do some things, but they don’t really feel as good as they used to. It’s just kind of hard for me to tell.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from activities that normally would bring you happiness?
I’m not sure I’d say I’m unable to feel pleasure at all. It’s more like… I don’t notice much happiness from things the way I think I should, but I can’t really tell if it’s completely gone.
Do you feel tired most of the time?

Yeah. I feel tired most of the time. Even small things, like filling out inspection logs at work or washing my hair, feel like they take more energy than I have. And even when I rest on my days off, it doesn’t really feel like it helps much.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight recently?

Yeah, my weight’s been kind of up and down. Most days I either don’t eat until my shift is almost over because nothing sounds good, or I just grab vending machine snacks late because I’m too drained. My work pants fit different from month to month, so I’ve noticed it.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?

Yeah, I have. I’ll be really exhausted after standing on the production floor all day, but once I get in bed my mind just keeps going over everything I’m behind on. And even when I do fall asleep, I wake up feeling like I barely rested.
Do you often feel guilty or worthless about things?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I get down on myself sometimes, but I don’t know if I’d call it feeling worthless. It’s more like… I just feel disappointed in myself a lot.
Do you ever think about death or dying?
I don’t really know. I mean, I don’t think about it in a clear way or anything. Sometimes I just feel tired of dealing with everything, but I’m not sure that’s the same as thinking about death.
Do you think about death or dying more often than you think a normal person would?
I’m not sure. I don’t really compare it to what’s normal. I wouldn’t say it’s something I’m clearly thinking about all the time, but I do get those moments where I just feel worn down.
Do you find yourself moving or speaking more slowly than you used to, or feeling like you're speeding up and can't calm down?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed myself speeding up or being unable to calm down. Maybe I’m slower sometimes, but I don’t know if that’s actually happening or just how I feel.
Do you feel like you're moving slower than you used to?
I’m not sure. I feel slowed down sometimes, but I don’t know if I’m actually moving slower than I used to or if it just feels that way.
Have you felt this low for most of the day, nearly every day, for the past two years?

Yeah. For the last couple years, I feel low most of the time, pretty much every day. Even when I’m at work or at church or around people I care about, it’s like this heavy, empty feeling is still there and it doesn’t really lift.
Have you had at least two years where you felt this low nearly every day?
Yes. It’s been about two years and four months now. It started around when I had to stop taking community college classes because I couldn’t make the money and my work schedule work.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things that other people couldn't hear or see?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t heard voices or seen things that other people couldn’t.
Do you think you're speaking more slowly than you used to?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed myself talking slower, but I guess I don’t always pay attention to that.
Do you think you have been restless or fidgety more often than usual?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’ve noticed being more fidgety or restless than usual.
Do you think you've been more fidgety than usual?
Not that I’ve really noticed. I mean, I might shift around sometimes, but I don’t think it’s more than usual.
Do you think you've been feeling more restless than usual?
I don’t really think so. I haven’t noticed feeling more restless than usual.
Have you ever had thoughts that you think aren't your own or that aren't based in reality?
I don’t think so. I mean, I have negative thoughts sometimes, but they feel like they’re coming from me, not like someone else put them there or anything.
